name: openbb_fixedincome_estr
description:
Euro short-term rate (ESTR, percent) history from FRED through the OpenBB Platform (obb.fixedincome.rate.estr).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fred only; schema default federal_reserve (also rejected), but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
US overnight rates: openbb_fixedincome_sofr, openbb_fixedincome_effr; ECB source: ecb_get_interest_rate. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "fred"}
